cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and in the early hours of Thursday, the 17th of September,
cues.zh: 我是 Alex Ritson。现在是9月17日星期四凌晨。

cues.en: these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 以下是本期主要新闻。

cues.en: The US Federal Reserve puts up interest rates for the first time in three years,
cues.zh: 美国联邦储备委员会三年来首次加息，

cues.en: despite loud calls from President Trump to lower them.
cues.zh: 尽管特朗普总统强烈要求降息。

cues.en: and athletes criticize conditions at the Asian Games in Japan.
cues.zh: 运动员批评日本亚运会的住宿条件。

cues.en: Some competitors can't even fit into the beds.
cues.zh: 有些参赛者甚至无法躺进床里。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, we build a new model that lets us capture aspects of human brain function in a way that wasn't possible before.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将介绍一种新模型，它让我们能够以前所未有的方式捕捉人脑功能的某些方面。

cues.en: Frankenstein rodents: we hear about the part mouse, part human brain, and the world's best pizza is apparently not found in Italy.
cues.zh: 我们将听到“弗兰肯斯坦”啮齿动物的故事：它们一半是老鼠，一半是人脑；而世界上最好的披萨似乎并不在意大利。

cues.en: Rising prices, soaring fuel rates, and the cost of living are hitting consumers and financial markets globally,
cues.zh: 不断上涨的物价、飙升的燃料价格和生活成本正在冲击全球消费者和金融市场，

cues.en: so much so that the US central bank, the Federal Reserve, is raising interest rates for the world's biggest economy for the first time in three years
cues.zh: 严重到美国央行美联储三年来首次为这个全球最大经济体加息，

cues.en: by a quarter of a percentage point in the hope it'll bring down inflation.
cues.zh: 加息四分之一个百分点，希望借此降低通胀。

cues.en: But the US president, who's demanded cuts, responded with a loud social media post,
cues.zh: 但要求降息的美国总统在社交媒体上发表了措辞强硬的帖子，

cues.en: writing in all caps, "Lower the interest rates for the United States of America and fast."
cues.zh: 用全大写字母写道：“赶快降低美利坚合众国的利率。”

cues.en: This is not the script Donald Trump expected from the man he appointed as the new Fed chair,
cues.zh: 这不是唐纳德·特朗普预想中由他任命的新任美联储主席写下的剧本，

cues.en: but Kevin Warsh says inflation is too high.
cues.zh: 但 Kevin Warsh 表示通胀仍然过高。

cues.en: While uncertainty remains elevated, owing in part to geopolitical developments, domestic spending has been resilient.
cues.zh: 尽管不确定性仍然很高，部分原因是地缘政治局势，但国内支出一直保持韧性。

cues.en: Productivity growth, strong, and capital investment is robust.
cues.zh: 生产率增长强劲，资本投资也很稳健。

cues.en: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little,
cues.zh: 就业增长跟上了劳动力规模，失业率几乎没有变化，

cues.en: but inflation remains elevated. Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the committee's 2% goal.
cues.zh: 但通胀仍然高企。今天的政策行动将支持更及时地回到委员会设定的2%目标。

cues.en: Our business correspondent in New York is Samira Hussein. She gave us her assessment.
cues.zh: 我们的纽约商业记者 Samira Hussein 分析了这一决定。

cues.en: Kevin Warsh says that the US economy is doing really well despite the geopolitical developments, as he put it,
cues.zh: Kevin Warsh 表示，正如他所说，尽管面临地缘政治局势，美国经济表现非常好，

cues.en: and presumably he's referring to the war with Iran, which has been a big driving factor for inflation in America right now.
cues.zh: 他大概指的是与伊朗的战争，这目前是美国通胀的一大推动因素。

cues.en: Inflation here has been running above the target rate of 2% for about five years, but it was hovering around 2.5%,
cues.zh: 美国通胀率约五年来一直高于2%的目标水平，但此前徘徊在2.5%左右，

cues.en: but now we're seeing this jump since February to 3.4%, and this is having a huge impact on all Americans.
cues.zh: 如今从2月起已跃升至3.4%，这对所有美国人都产生了巨大影响。

cues.en: They are paying much more for the same things they did just a year ago, putting a lot of pressure on American consumers.
cues.zh: 他们不得不为同样的东西付出比一年前多得多的钱，这给美国消费者带来了很大压力。

cues.en: And now they're going to have to pay more for their interest rates. It's going to hurt, isn't it?
cues.zh: 现在他们还得支付更高的利息。这会让人很难受，对吧？

cues.en: It's going to hurt for those people that are looking to borrow money.
cues.zh: 对于想借钱的人来说，这会造成伤害。

cues.en: It's going to put pressure on those people that are looking to buy a home or get a car loan.
cues.zh: 对于想买房或申请汽车贷款的人来说，这会带来压力。

cues.en: But what Kevin Warsh was trying to say in the press conference is that this is about the American consumer,
cues.zh: 但 Kevin Warsh 在记者会上想表达的是，这关乎美国消费者，

cues.en: and very much the consumer that is living paycheck to paycheck,
cues.zh: 尤其是那些靠一张张工资支票勉强度日的消费者，

cues.en: where the cost of living has been so high and it is making it very difficult for people to make ends meet.
cues.zh: 生活成本如此之高，让人们很难维持生计。

cues.en: Even when you look at the labor market, which Kevin Warsh also said is doing really well in the United States,
cues.zh: 即使观察劳动力市场，Kevin Warsh 也说美国的劳动力市场表现很好，

cues.en: you see that wages aren't going up in line with inflation,
cues.zh: 也会发现工资涨幅没有跟上通胀，

cues.en: and that's also making it even harder for the American consumer.
cues.zh: 这也让美国消费者的处境更加艰难。

cues.en: This is like the bottom interest rate, though. This is the interest rate upon which everything else is set:
cues.zh: 不过，这就像是基准利率，是其他一切利率的基础：

cues.en: 3.75 to 4%, plus whatever your lender adds on the top.
cues.zh: 3.75%到4%，再加上贷款方的加点。

cues.en: People aren't used to interest rates at this level, are they?
cues.zh: 人们已经不习惯这么高的利率了，对吧？

cues.en: We certainly haven't seen interest rates this high in a very long time.
cues.zh: 我们确实已经很久没见过这么高的利率了。

cues.en: And then if you look at the bond market, the 10-year Treasury yield,
cues.zh: 再看债券市场，10年期美国国债收益率，

cues.en: which is also a big indicator, and perhaps more of an indicator in terms of what your mortgage rate is going to be here in the United States,
cues.zh: 这也是一个重要指标，或许更能反映美国的抵押贷款利率，

cues.en: we're looking at mortgage rates that are in the 7% realm.
cues.zh: 目前抵押贷款利率约为7%。

cues.en: And just six, eight months ago, you could still get a mortgage for about, you know, 3 to 4%.
cues.zh: 而就在六到八个月前，人们仍能以大约3%到4%的利率获得抵押贷款。

cues.en: So it's been really dramatic increases, and it's going to start putting a lot of pressure on different parts of the American economy.
cues.zh: 所以利率涨幅非常惊人，将开始给美国经济的不同领域带来很大压力。

cues.en: And this is an international issue, isn't it? Everyone else is facing a rise, too.
cues.zh: 这也是一个国际性问题，对吧？其他国家也都面临利率上升。

cues.en: Everyone else is facing a rise, because everyone else is also facing inflation, because everyone else is also facing similar inflationary pressures
cues.zh: 其他国家也都面临利率上升，因为同样面临通胀，以及类似的通胀压力

cues.en: because of the high cost of energy.
cues.zh: 这是由高昂的能源成本造成的。

cues.en: We didn't think Donald Trump was going to like this, and he doesn't, does he?
cues.zh: 我们没想到唐纳德·特朗普会喜欢这样，但他确实不喜欢，对吧？

cues.en: He's already responded. He has responded, saying that, look, interest rates should be at 1% or lower.
cues.zh: 他已经作出回应了。他说，利率应该是1%或更低。

cues.en: The interesting thing to me about this is that the criticism was related to interest rates only,
cues.zh: 在我看来，有意思的是，他的批评只针对利率，

cues.en: and he didn't resort to personal attacks against Kevin Warsh.
cues.zh: 并没有对凯文·沃什进行人身攻击。

cues.en: And if you'll remember, his predecessor, the Fed chair, former Fed chair Jerome Powell,
cues.zh: 还记得吗？他的前任、美联储主席，也就是前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔，

cues.en: faced a litany of criticisms, both personally and for his performance as Fed chair, from the president of the United States.
cues.zh: 曾遭到美国总统大量批评，既有人身攻击，也有对他担任美联储主席表现的批评。

cues.en: Perhaps Kevin Warsh is a little bit saved, given that he was appointed by President Trump himself.
cues.zh: 或许凯文·沃什能稍微幸免，毕竟他是特朗普总统亲自任命的。

cues.en: Our US business correspondent, Samira Hussein.
cues.zh: 本台驻美国商业记者萨米拉·侯赛因。

cues.en: Now, neuroscientists in the United States have created laboratory mice with functioning human cells in their brains.
cues.zh: 美国神经科学家培育出脑内有正常运作人类细胞的实验鼠。

cues.en: The rodents are genetically engineered and surgically altered so most of their cortex is of human origin.
cues.zh: 这些啮齿动物经过基因工程和手术改造，大部分大脑皮层源自人类。

cues.en: The team from Stanford University say it could help researchers develop treatments for psychiatric diseases.
cues.zh: 斯坦福大学团队称，这或有助于研究人员开发精神疾病疗法。

cues.en: More details from our science correspondent, Victoria Gill.
cues.zh: 科学记者维多利亚·吉尔带来更多详情。

cues.en: While mice with partly human brains might sound like a Kafkaesque experiment,
cues.zh: 拥有部分人类大脑的老鼠听起来像卡夫卡式实验，

cues.en: the scientists say that these are not mice that think like humans.
cues.zh: 但科学家说，这些老鼠并不会像人类一样思考。

cues.en: Rather, they're animals that are altered so that some of their brain tissue is human.
cues.zh: 它们只是经过改造，使部分脑组织成为人类组织的动物。

cues.en: The researchers engineered mice to develop almost none of their own cerebral cortex, that's the outer layer
cues.zh: 研究人员让老鼠几乎不发育自身的大脑皮层，也就是大脑的外层，

cues.en: that's sometimes referred to as grey matter. It handles higher-level thinking, memory, and senses.
cues.zh: 这层有时称为灰质，负责高阶思维、记忆和感知。

cues.en: They then used skin cells taken from humans, reprogrammed them and grew them into pieces
cues.zh: 他们随后取用人类皮肤细胞，重新编程并培育成一些脑样组织，

cues.en: of brain-like tissue called organoids—collections of connected, living brain cells.
cues.zh: 称为类器官，即相互连接的活脑细胞集合。

cues.en: When implanted into the mice, these organoids formed connections with the rest of the brain and spinal cord.
cues.zh: 这些类器官植入老鼠后，与大脑其他部分及脊髓形成了连接。

cues.en: functioning like brain tissue.
cues.zh: 并像脑组织一样运作。

cues.en: Having working human brain cells inside a living animal, the scientists say, gives them a new way to understand
cues.zh: 科学家说，活体动物体内有正常运作的人类脑细胞，让他们有了新的方式去理解

cues.en: the biological causes and develop treatments for brain disorders, including dementia, epilepsy and cerebral palsy.
cues.zh: 脑部疾病的生物学成因，并开发治疗痴呆、癫痫和脑瘫的疗法。

cues.en: Understanding disorders of the brain is really, really difficult.
cues.zh: 理解脑部疾病确实非常、非常困难。

cues.en: That's lead researcher, Professor Sergiu Pasca, from Stanford University in the US.
cues.zh: 这是首席研究员、美国斯坦福大学的Sergiu Pasca教授。

cues.en: These disorders are having devastating consequences. We need better models—models that include human cells.
cues.zh: 这些疾病造成了毁灭性后果。我们需要更好的模型，包含人类细胞的模型。

cues.en: So here we build a new model that allows us to actually capture aspects of human brain function
cues.zh: 因此，我们构建了一个新模型，能够真正捕捉人类大脑功能的某些方面，

cues.en: in a way that has not been possible before.
cues.zh: 这是此前从未实现过的方式。

cues.en: The study raises questions about what it means to change the brain of an animal
cues.zh: 这项研究引发了疑问：改变动物的大脑意味着什么，

cues.en: and exactly how these laboratory mice will experience the world,
cues.zh: 以及这些实验鼠究竟会如何感知世界。

cues.en: so there'll be ongoing discussions weighing the scientific value of these mice against these ethical challenges. Victoria Gill.
cues.zh: 因此，人们将持续讨论这些老鼠的科学价值与伦理挑战之间的权衡。维多利亚·吉尔报道。

cues.en: Thousands of athletes from more than 40 countries and regions are getting ready for the Asian Games, which are being held in Japan.
cues.zh: 来自40多个国家和地区的数千名运动员，正为在日本举行的亚运会做准备。

cues.en: But just a couple of days before the event begins, there have been numerous complaints about the athletes' accommodation.
cues.zh: 但就在赛事开幕前几天，运动员住宿条件引发了大量投诉。

cues.en: The Games in the city of Nagoya officially open on Saturday, but football and basketball are already underway.
cues.zh: 赛事将在名古屋于周六正式开幕，但足球和篮球比赛已经开始。

cues.en: For more on what the complaints centre on, I spoke to our correspondent Kurumi Mori, who's in Tokyo.
cues.zh: 关于投诉的具体内容，我采访了驻东京记者森久留美。

cues.en: These athletes are complaining about several things regarding accommodation, one being that they're just not big enough.
cues.zh: 运动员抱怨住宿的多个方面，其中一点是房间实在不够大。

cues.en: Quite literally, some of the basketball athletes are saying that the beds are too short
cues.zh: 确实有篮球运动员说，床铺太短，

cues.en: and they're not able to lie down fully on these beds.
cues.zh: 他们无法在床上完全躺平。

cues.en: So you can imagine how uncomfortable that must be for athletes set to compete.
cues.zh: 可以想象，这对即将参赛的运动员来说一定很不舒服。

cues.en: There have also been complaints about the condition of the rooms
cues.zh: 此外，房间状况也受到投诉，

cues.en: including a video showing a leaking pipe and a soaked floor, a flooded floor,
cues.zh: 有视频显示管道漏水，地板被浸湿、淹没，

cues.en: because we had some heavy rains here in Japan that really added to this disruption and the complaints.
cues.zh: 因为日本当地的暴雨进一步加剧了混乱和投诉。

cues.en: Several hundred people from the Games were briefly evacuated from their accommodation last week when we had the heavy rains flooding through Nagoya.
cues.zh: 上周暴雨导致名古屋发生洪水，数百名参赛人员一度被疏散出住宿地点。

cues.en: And I'm told cruise ships have been sent to Nagoya to accommodate the athletes.
cues.zh: 我还听说，游轮已经被派往名古屋安置运动员。

cues.en: Yeah, and you know, that's probably the most unusual part of this accommodation story.
cues.zh: 是的，你知道，这大概是住宿故事中最不寻常的部分。

cues.en: Organizers decided not to really build a traditional athletes' village like they did in the Tokyo Olympics.
cues.zh: 组织者决定不建造像东京奥运会那样的传统运动员村。

cues.en: So they've had to get creative to be able to house all of the athletes that are here. I mean, this is a massive event.
cues.zh: 所以他们不得不想办法安置所有来到这里的运动员。我的意思是，这是一项规模巨大的赛事。

cues.en: The Asian Games have more athlete involvement than even the Summer Olympics in Paris.
cues.zh: 亚运会的运动员参与人数甚至超过了巴黎夏季奥运会。

cues.en: So it is a huge number of people coming here.
cues.zh: 所以，来到这里的人数非常庞大。

cues.en: They had an Italian cruise ship arriving in Nagoya to house around 4,000 athletes and officials.
cues.zh: 他们安排了一艘意大利游轮抵达名古屋，容纳约4,000名运动员和官员。

cues.en: Other people are staying in hotels, Airbnbs, and also temporary huts as well.
cues.zh: 其他人住在酒店、爱彼迎住所和临时小屋里。

cues.en: But the cruise ship, they're saying, it's the first time that Japan has used this kind of facility for a major international sporting event.
cues.zh: 但他们说，这艘游轮是日本首次将这类设施用于大型国际体育赛事。

cues.en: And they're saying it's a sustainable alternative to build a temporary living space for the athletes.
cues.zh: 他们还说，这是为运动员建造临时居住空间的一种可持续替代方案。

cues.en: Have the organizers responded to the criticism?
cues.zh: 组织者回应这些批评了吗？

cues.en: They are saying that basically, we hear you and we're working on it.
cues.zh: 他们基本上是在说：我们听到了你们的意见，正在处理。

cues.en: The managers are saying that they've taken steps to improve the conditions for the athletes that are there.
cues.zh: 管理人员表示，他们已经采取措施改善那里的运动员住宿条件。

cues.en: They've also set up a 24-hour call center where athletes and officials can come and report some problems.
cues.zh: 他们还设立了24小时呼叫中心，运动员和官员可以在那里报告问题。

cues.en: And try to mitigate some of these issues.
cues.zh: 并设法缓解其中一些问题。

cues.en: But part of the challenge is that these Games were expected initially to have around 15,000 athletes.
cues.zh: 但挑战之一是，最初预计这届赛事会有约15,000名运动员。

cues.en: And officials participating, but that number rose to about 17,000.
cues.zh: 以及官员参加，但这个数字后来增加到了约17,000人。

cues.en: Pretty late in the game, and so they hadn't planned for this many people.
cues.zh: 而且是在筹备后期才增加的，因此他们没有为这么多人做准备。

cues.en: They say that everyone is now, though, guaranteed accommodation.
cues.zh: 不过他们说，现在每个人都能得到住宿安排。

cues.en: And saying that this whole plan was trying to be built around sustainability.
cues.zh: 他们还说，整个计划都是围绕可持续性制定的。

cues.en: Kurumi Mori in Tokyo.
cues.zh: 东京的森久留美报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast...
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有……

cues.en: He dealt with the fire and getting me out of the car and everything. He did every step right.
cues.zh: 他处理了火势，把我从车里救出来，处理好了一切。他每一步都做得很正确。

cues.en: And it's, you know, quite rightly created this really strong bond between us.
cues.zh: 而且，正如你所知，这理所当然地在我们之间建立了非常深厚的纽带。

cues.en: The racing driver rescued from a burning car by his rival gets to thank his saviour.
cues.zh: 那名被对手从燃烧的赛车中救出的赛车手得以向救命恩人道谢。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: One of Nigeria's best-known actors has died. In a career spanning more than five decades,
cues.zh: 尼日利亚最知名的演员之一去世了。他的演艺生涯跨越五十多年，

cues.en: Olu Jacobs was hailed as a pioneer of Nollywood, Nigeria's homegrown film industry.
cues.zh: 奥卢·雅各布斯被誉为诺莱坞——尼日利亚本土电影业的先驱。

cues.en: Richard Hamilton looks back on his life.
cues.zh: 理查德·汉密尔顿回顾了他的一生。

cues.en: Olu Jacobs was born in southwestern Nigeria, but spent his formative years in the northern city of Kano.
cues.zh: 奥卢·雅各布斯出生于尼日利亚西南部，但在北部城市卡诺度过了成长岁月。

cues.en: There he was inspired to take up acting after seeing a performance by the Nigerian actor Hubert Ogunde at the city's Colonial Hotel.
cues.zh: 在那里，他观看尼日利亚演员休伯特·奥贡德在当地殖民酒店的演出后，受到启发而开始演戏。

cues.en: He travelled to London and studied at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Arts, or RADA.
cues.zh: 他前往伦敦，就读于皇家戏剧艺术学院，也就是RADA。

cues.en: He featured in several British TV shows and stage plays in the 1970s before moving into international films.
cues.zh: 20世纪70年代，他出演了多部英国电视节目和舞台剧，之后进军国际电影。

cues.en: Brown. Keith Brown, yes.
cues.zh: 布朗。基思·布朗，是的。

cues.en: What business do you have in Zangaro?
cues.zh: 你在赞加罗做什么工作？

cues.en: I work for a nature magazine. I take pictures of birds.
cues.zh: 我为一本自然杂志工作，拍摄鸟类照片。

cues.en: Here he is playing an immigration officer in the 1980 action movie The Dogs of War,
cues.zh: 这是他在1980年的动作电影《战争猛犬》中饰演移民官员的片段，

cues.en: in a tense dialogue with Christopher Walken, who plays a mercenary.
cues.zh: 他与饰演雇佣兵的克里斯托弗·沃肯展开了一段紧张对话。

cues.en: Do you have a drinking problem, Mr. Brown?
cues.zh: 你有酗酒问题吗，布朗先生？

cues.en: I thought there might be a problem with the water.
cues.zh: 我以为可能是水出了问题。

cues.en: There is.
cues.zh: 确实是。

cues.en: Jacobs subsequently returned to his homeland and was instrumental in starting Nigeria's homegrown movie industry, or Nollywood, in the early 1990s.
cues.zh: 之后，雅各布斯回到祖国，并在20世纪90年代初创建尼日利亚本土电影业诺莱坞的过程中发挥了重要作用。

cues.en: In total, he starred in more than 120 Nollywood films,
cues.zh: 他总共出演了120多部诺莱坞电影，

cues.en: in which he was revered for his commanding screen presence and depth of character portrayal.
cues.zh: 凭借强大的银幕气场和深刻的人物塑造，他备受尊敬。

cues.en: Together with his wife, Joke Silva, he founded the Lufodo Group, which was committed to the development of the performing arts in Nigeria.
cues.zh: 他与妻子乔克·席尔瓦共同创办了卢福多集团，致力于发展尼日利亚表演艺术。

cues.en: Interviewed on Nigerian television a few years ago, he talked about the need to nurture talent inside the country.
cues.zh: 几年前接受尼日利亚电视台采访时，他谈到了培养国内人才的必要性。

cues.en: I'm really, very, very excited.
cues.zh: 我真的非常非常激动。

cues.en: Because the avenue for our children to begin to express themselves positively and
cues.zh: 因为这为我们的孩子提供了渠道，让他们开始积极地表达自己，

cues.en: confidently is very, very important.
cues.zh: 自信地表达非常重要。

cues.en: You know, there was a time when, and not too long ago,
cues.zh: 你知道，不久以前，曾经有一段时期，

cues.en: when everything that we did was measured against what the Europeans did.
cues.zh: 我们所做的一切都要拿来和欧洲人所做的比较。

cues.en: What they did was the best and ours was the worst.
cues.zh: 他们做的是最好的，而我们做的是最差的。

cues.en: But our children, even being born in foreign land, don't think so anymore.
cues.zh: 但我们的孩子，即使出生在外国，也不再这样认为。

cues.en: They know that we're capable. We may have our faults.
cues.zh: 他们知道我们有能力。我们可能有缺点。

cues.en: More and more are coming home.
cues.zh: 越来越多的人正在回到家乡。

cues.en: They are coming home and they're staying home, and they are productive.
cues.zh: 他们回到家乡、留在家乡，并且有所作为。

cues.en: You know, and I am very, very happy. I am proud of that.
cues.zh: 你知道，我对此感到非常非常高兴，也感到自豪。

cues.en: Olu Jacobs won a string of prestigious trophies, including the Africa Movie Academy Award for Best Actor and the Industry Merit Award for Outstanding Achievements.
cues.zh: Olu Jacobs 曾获得一系列重要奖项，包括非洲电影学院最佳男演员奖和行业成就奖。

cues.en: In 2011, he was given the Member of the Order of the Federal Republic by the then President Goodluck Jonathan.
cues.zh: 2011年，时任总统古德勒克·乔纳森授予他联邦共和国勋章成员称号。

cues.en: But rumours that Jacobs had died emerged in 2021, until he turned up at that year's Africa International Film Festival, where he was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement Award.
cues.zh: 但2021年出现了雅各布斯去世的传闻；后来他现身当年的非洲国际电影节，并获终身成就奖。

cues.en: The former Vice President, Atiku Abubakar, described Jacobs as a cultural icon. His wife called him the Lion of Lufodo.
cues.zh: 前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔称他为文化偶像。他的妻子称他为“卢福多之狮”。

cues.en: Richard Hamilton on the life of the Nigerian actor Olu Jacobs, who has died at the age of 84.
cues.zh: 理查德·汉密尔顿介绍已故尼日利亚演员奥卢·雅各布斯的一生；他享年84岁。

cues.en: Sepsis is a life-threatening condition which kills about one in five affected people. It's the body's overreaction to an infection.
cues.zh: 败血症是一种危及生命的疾病，患者约有五分之一会因此死亡。这是身体对感染的过度反应。

cues.en: This leads to shock and organ failure. For doctors, it's a race against time to find out the cause of the infection to treat it.
cues.zh: 这种反应会导致休克和器官衰竭。对医生来说，找出感染原因并治疗，是与时间赛跑。

cues.en: But currently, it can take up to a week to find out which bug or pathogen is behind the patient's rapid decline.
cues.zh: 但目前，要查明导致患者迅速恶化的细菌或病原体，可能需要一周。

cues.en: But researchers in Scotland and Germany are developing a new blood test that could dramatically reduce that time, delivering results within hours.
cues.zh: 不过，苏格兰和德国的研究人员正在开发一种新血检，有望大幅缩短时间，在数小时内给出结果。

cues.en: Dr Ron Daniels, founder and chief medical officer of the UK Sepsis Trust, explains why this could be a game-changer.
cues.zh: 英国败血症信托基金创始人兼首席医疗官罗恩·丹尼尔斯博士解释了它为何可能改变局面。

cues.en: Sepsis is one of the most time-critical conditions that we face in healthcare. In the most severe cases, it's not even that every hour counts in treating it; every minute counts.
cues.zh: 败血症是医疗领域最需要争分夺秒的疾病之一。最严重时，不只是每小时重要，而是每一分钟都重要。

cues.en: But we know that across the spectrum of sepsis, it can range from very rapidly progressive to more slowly progressive.
cues.zh: 但我们知道，败血症的进程各不相同，可能迅速恶化，也可能进展较慢。

cues.en: Getting the right treatment within the first hour, or at worst within the first three hours, can often make the difference between life and death.
cues.zh: 及时接受正确治疗，最好在第一小时内，最迟也应在前三小时内，往往能决定生死。

cues.en: Professor Maïwenn Kersaudy-Kerhoas of Heriot-Watt's Global Research Institute in Health and Care Technologies told Laura Maciver about the new rapid test.
cues.zh: 赫瑞瓦特大学健康与护理技术全球研究院的麦温·凯尔萨迪-凯尔霍阿斯教授介绍了团队正在研发的新型快速检测。

cues.en: My team at Heriot-Watt has developed a way to detect these sepsis-causing microbes in a matter of hours rather than days.
cues.zh: 她的团队已找到一种方法，可在数小时而非数日内检测导致败血症的微生物。

cues.en: So instead of waiting for samples to be cultured, that means growing the pathogens.
cues.zh: 也就是说，不必等待培养样本，也就是让病原体生长。

cues.en: Instead of growing the microbes, we catch the DNA shed by them in our bloodstream. It uses the same blood sample as a normal test would.
cues.zh: 我们捕捉的是这些微生物在血液中释放的DNA，并使用与普通检测相同的血样。

cues.en: But we can entirely skip the blood culture, which takes days, by analysing directly these bits of DNA.
cues.zh: 但我们可以完全跳过需要数日的血培养，直接分析这些DNA片段。

cues.en: We worked on a pilot, so we received samples from patients in Germany, and we had some really good results.
cues.zh: 我们开展了一项试点研究，从德国患者那里收集样本，结果相当不错。

cues.en: Including a clinical case where we had a young woman in her thirties with a urinary tract infection, and the blood culture had completely failed.
cues.zh: 其中一个病例是一名30多岁的年轻女性，患有尿路感染，但血培养完全失败。

cues.en: So after seven or nine days, they were still not able to say what the problem was.
cues.zh: 七或九天后，他们仍无法判断问题所在。

cues.en: But we were able to detect, using our test, traces of the DNA left by the microbes causing the infection.
cues.zh: 但我们能够用检测发现造成感染的微生物留下的DNA痕迹。

cues.en: And we were able to match these findings with their other type of cultures.
cues.zh: 并把这些结果与另一种培养检测的结果进行匹配。

cues.en: So now we have just received more funding from the state of Rhineland-Palatinate in Germany, and that will enable us to acquire more samples.
cues.zh: 现在，我们获得了德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨州的更多资金，这将让我们获得更多样本。

cues.en: In order to further validate the tests, and hopefully bring it closer to patients.
cues.zh: 以进一步验证检测，并希望让它更接近临床患者。

cues.en: So what kind of difference do you think this could end up making, Maïwenn?
cues.zh: 那么，麦温，你认为这最终会带来怎样的改变？

cues.en: I think our test could make a big difference to patients.
cues.zh: 我认为，我们的检测会给患者带来很大改变。

cues.en: So instead of waiting days, the clinical care team would have the results on the same day or maybe next day, and that means they could administer the right treatments.
cues.zh: 临床护理团队不必等待数日，而能在当天或次日拿到结果，从而实施正确治疗。

cues.en: So potentially saving lives in some cases, maybe getting you out of hospital more quickly.
cues.zh: 这或许能挽救一些生命，让患者更快出院。

cues.en: And by administering the right targeted treatments, they could reduce antibiotic resistance.
cues.zh: 通过给予针对性治疗，还可能减少抗生素耐药性。

cues.en: Professor Maïwenn Kersaudy-Kerhoas of Heriot-Watt University.
cues.zh: 麦温·凯尔萨迪-凯尔霍阿斯，赫瑞瓦特大学教授。

cues.en: Now, who makes the best pizzas? Maybe chefs from Naples, Rome or New York spring to mind.
cues.zh: 现在，谁做的披萨最好？人们或许会想到那不勒斯、罗马或纽约的厨师。

cues.en: Well, according to a jury for the 50 Top Pizza World 2026 contest, the best slice of pizza comes from London.
cues.zh: 不过，50 Top Pizza World 2026大赛的评委认为，世界上最好的一片披萨来自伦敦。

cues.en: You can sample them at one of Napoli on the Road's three branches.
cues.zh: 你可以在 Napoli on the Road 的三家分店品尝到它。

cues.en: As the name suggests, they serve classic Neapolitan pizza with its charred, doughy crust.
cues.zh: 顾名思义，他们供应经典那不勒斯披萨，饼底焦香而有嚼劲。

cues.en: The BBC's Adriana Urbano, who is herself Italian, went along to have a taste.
cues.zh: BBC记者阿德里安娜·乌尔巴诺本人就是意大利人，她前去品尝。

cues.en: So here they are, two Napoli-style pizzas with their thick borders and a nice thin base that I have been assured will not flop.
cues.zh: 这两款那不勒斯风格披萨摆在这里：边缘厚实，底部很薄，而且有人向我保证不会塌。

cues.en: The first one I will be trying is a classic Margherita, but I've also ordered a Ricordo d'Infanzia.
cues.zh: 我先尝经典玛格丽特披萨，还点了一款名为 Ricordo d'Infanzia 的披萨。

cues.en: It's a pizza whose name means childhood memory.
cues.zh: 这是一款名字意为“童年记忆”的披萨。

cues.en: It's got ragù, Parmigiano fondue, and a lot of extra Parmigiano shaving on top.
cues.zh: 上面有肉酱、帕尔马干酪火锅奶酪，还有许多额外刨下的帕尔马干酪。

cues.en: The Margherita first. Now, I have lived 21 years of my life in Italy, and this is a very good, tasty pizza.
cues.zh: 先尝玛格丽特披萨。我一生有21年在意大利度过，这是一款非常美味的披萨。

cues.en: The buffalo mozzarella is very stringy, it's got a lovely texture in the dough, and there's a nice thick border.
cues.zh: 水牛奶酪拉丝感很强，面团口感极佳，还有漂亮的厚边。

cues.en: And now, Ricordo d'Infanzia, the award-winning pizza, it's got a lovely thick ragù base,
cues.zh: 现在尝获奖披萨 Ricordo d'Infanzia，它有漂亮厚实的肉酱底，

cues.en: just like the kind of ragù Italians would eat up and down the country as part of many Sunday meals.
cues.zh: 就像意大利全国各地许多周日餐食中会吃的那种肉酱。

cues.en: I have to say, I can see where the hype is coming from.
cues.zh: 不得不说，我明白它为何如此受追捧。

cues.en: Napoli on the Road is the passion project of Michele Pascarella, who learned his trade as a boy in Campania, the region of Italy home to Naples, before moving to London.
cues.zh: Napoli on the Road 是 Michele Pascarella 的心血之作。他在意大利坎帕尼亚大区学艺，后移居伦敦。

cues.en: He gave the BBC his reaction to winning the award.
cues.zh: 他向 BBC 讲述了获奖后的感受。

cues.en: Still can't believe it's just happened.
cues.zh: 我仍然不敢相信这一切刚刚发生。

cues.en: I am very, very happy, and of course I am very, very proud also about the team.
cues.zh: 我非常非常开心，当然也为团队感到非常非常自豪。

cues.en: We got like 90 people that work with us, so we are very proud of what we achieved actually.
cues.zh: 我们有大约90人和我们一起工作，所以我们确实为取得的成就感到非常自豪。

cues.en: Yes, I was like.
cues.zh: 是的，我当时就像是——

cues.en: Singing the song "it's finally coming home" because we won best pizzeria in Europe for three years in a row.
cues.zh: 我唱着“它终于回家了”这首歌，因为我们连续三年赢得欧洲最佳披萨店称号。

cues.en: Best pizzeria in Europe, but outside Italy.
cues.zh: 是意大利之外的欧洲最佳披萨店。

cues.en: But this time we won best pizzeria in the world, including Italy.
cues.zh: 但这次我们赢得了包括意大利在内的全球最佳披萨店称号。

cues.en: So it was very, very, very beautiful.
cues.zh: 所以这真的非常非常非常美好。

cues.en: We are like always trying to evolve our product.
cues.zh: 我们一直在努力改进我们的产品。

cues.en: We focus on really high quality ingredients.
cues.zh: 我们注重品质非常高的食材。

cues.en: We change our menu every three months.
cues.zh: 我们每三个月更换一次菜单。

cues.en: And, you know, lots of restaurants and pizzerias just think about pizza as fast food,
cues.zh: 你知道，许多餐厅和披萨店只把披萨看作快餐，

cues.en: but pizza is like a serious thing
cues.zh: 但披萨是一件严肃的事情，

cues.en: and we love, and I think we did very good to explain to our customers that we are doing something different on the pizza.
cues.zh: 我们热爱披萨，而且我认为我们很好地向顾客解释了，我们做的是与众不同的披萨。

cues.en: Michele Pascarella of Napoli on the Road.
cues.zh: Napoli on the Road 的 Michele Pascarella。

cues.en: Finally, earlier this month, you may have seen dramatic footage of a racing driver being pulled from his burning car by one of his rivals at a race in China.
cues.zh: 最后，本月早些时候，你可能看过一段惊险画面：一名赛车手在中国参加比赛时，被一名对手从燃烧的赛车中拉出。

cues.en: Luke Hartog's act of heroism, stopping his car to rescue a barely conscious Ollie Millroy stuck in the wreckage, saved Millroy's life.
cues.zh: Luke Hartog 停车救出困在残骸中、意识几乎不清醒的 Ollie Millroy，这一英勇行为挽救了 Millroy 的生命。

cues.en: He suffered multiple fractures and a punctured lung in the impact, and is recovering in hospital.
cues.zh: 撞击导致他多处骨折和肺部穿孔，目前正在医院恢复。

cues.en: The pair have been speaking together for the first time since the crash in an interview with the BBC.
cues.zh: 两人事故后首次共同接受采访，讲述了这段经历。

cues.en: First, we heard from Luke Hartog.
cues.zh: 首先，我们听听 Luke Hartog 的讲述。

cues.en: We haven't had the chance to see each other like this, face-to-face yet.
cues.zh: 我们还没有机会像这样面对面见过彼此。

cues.en: Truthfully, that's the only thing I really care about.
cues.zh: 说实话，那是我唯一真正关心的事。

cues.en: I was prepared for things becoming a bit worse, sort of, such as a traumatic experience, but it really wasn't.
cues.zh: 我已经做好了情况变得更糟的准备，比如经历创伤，但事实并非如此。

cues.en: Because, and I think Ollie and I both believe in this,
cues.zh: 因为我和 Ollie 都相信这一点，

cues.en: how racing kind of teaches you to do acts like this is, is a kind of, kind of natural thing.
cues.zh: 赛车教会你做出这样的举动，这似乎是一种自然而然的事情。

cues.en: Kind of natural thing, therefore, it's just very healing in some way to speak with Ollie.
cues.zh: 这是一种自然而然的事情，所以能和 Ollie 交谈，对我来说在某种程度上很有疗愈作用。

cues.en: It's honestly the strangest feeling when you watch the onboard video from Luke's car.
cues.zh: 观看 Luke 赛车上的车载视频时，感觉确实非常奇怪。

cues.en: As soon as my car started going up in flames, he aimed for me as though it had been pre-programmed or rehearsed.
cues.zh: 我的赛车一开始燃烧，他就朝我驶来，仿佛这一切经过预先编程或排练。

cues.en: It was the weirdest thing, you know.
cues.zh: 那真是最奇怪的事情，你知道。

cues.en: And even the way that he dealt with the fire and getting me out of the car and everything, he did every step right,
cues.zh: 甚至他处理火势、把我从车里救出来以及所做的一切，每一步都做对了，

cues.en: and it's, you know, quite rightly created this really strong bond between us.
cues.zh: 你知道，这理所当然地在我们之间建立了非常深厚的纽带。

cues.en: I didn't have any memory of the accident at all, so the first time that anyone talked me through it was actually Luke himself in hospital.
cues.zh: 我完全不记得那场事故，所以第一次有人向我讲述经过，实际上是在医院里的 Luke 本人。

cues.en: And I remember the two of us were just in floods of tears
cues.zh: 我记得我们两人当时都泪流满面，

cues.en: when we, just when you were telling me what happened and what you did, and, you know, how different the result could have been for me.
cues.zh: 就在你告诉我发生了什么、你做了什么时，你知道，结果本来可能对我完全不同。

cues.en: Ollie Millroy thanking rival Luke Hartog for saving his life by pulling him from his burning Ferrari during a race.
cues.zh: Ollie Millroy 感谢对手 Luke Hartog 在比赛中将他从燃烧的法拉利赛车中拉出，救了他的命。

cues.en: In Shanghai, and that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 地点在上海。以上就是我们目前的全部内容。

cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.zh: 你也可以在 X 上关注 BBC World Service。

cues.zh: 请使用话题标签 #globalnewspod。

cues.zh: 本期《Global News Podcast》由 Holly Smith 混音。

cues.zh: 制片人是 Stephanie Zachariason。

cues.zh: 编辑是 Karen Martin。

cues.zh: 我是 Alex Ritson。

cues.zh: 下次再见。
